Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I've been researching IELTS and English training centres in Bangladesh, and MIE English Academy with 7 Dhaka branches is a serious operation. The biggest leak in education businesses is usually in lead conversion — students enquire about courses via phone or Facebook, but there's no automated way to qualify them (what band score do they need? when is their test date? what's their current level?) before a counsellor spends time on a call.

Here's the pattern I see: a student messages your Facebook page asking about IELTS preparation. Right now, someone manually replies, asks about their target score and test date, schedules a placement test, and follows up. For 7 branches, that's a lot of manual coordination, and leads go cold when replies are delayed by even a few hours.

I built an AI education consultant agent that handles enquiries 24/7 — it asks about target band score, test date, current English level, and preferred branch, then recommends the right course, schedules a placement test, and sends automated reminders. It also follows up with students who enquired but didn't enrol.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
